learning_outcomes.text: Students will gain general knowledge about Istanbul and learn about current academic studies.
Students will acquire the ability to think analytically and conduct research.
Students will gain comparative analysis skills.
Students will learn to understand Istanbul from a multi-disciplinary perspective.
Students will understand the role of social change.

syllabus_topics: Analyses on the Conquest of Istanbul
Households and Families in late 19th and early 20th century Istanbul
Industrialization, Migration and the Formation of Shantytowns in the 1960s
Globalization and the Emergence of Informal Sectors: The Laleli Case
Globalization, Consumer Culture, Museums and Festivalism
